name: Texas Injection Molding LLC
description: Texas Injection Molding LLC is a contract manufacturer of custom plastic injection molded parts, founded in 2013 and based in Houston, Texas. Its 90,000-square-foot plant runs injection molding machines from 40 to more than 1,350 tons. Services include design for manufacturability, tool design, engineering support, decoration, assembly and custom nylon fabrication. The company is ISO 9001:2015 certified and FDA listed. It supplies customers in Mexico, Canada and the United States in markets such as construction and building systems, data center hardware, energy, food and beverage, and medical and pharmaceutical products.

name: The Flying Cow Shirt Company
description: Established in 1973 as “Greek World,” the company initially served the vibrant Greek life at the University of Missouri. This period was characterized by a deep understanding of the specific needs of sororities and fraternities, who often required custom apparel for events, philanthropies, and chapter unity. This specialized focus allowed "Greek World" to build strong relationships and a reputation for quality within this particular demographic. As the company matured, its client base naturally diversified. Local businesses seeking branded merchandise, schools ordering uniforms or spirit wear, and various other organizations requiring custom printed items began to represent a significant portion of their custom apparel orders. Recognizing this expanding market opportunity, it was decided a change was needed.
